question: Who among the following was awarded with ‘Padma Vibhushan' in the year 1986 and choreographed famous song 'Kahe Chhed Mohe' from the movie Devdas and 'Mohe Rang Do Laal' from Bajirao Mastani?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Birju Maharaj.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Birju Maharaj** was awarded with** Padma Vibhushan** in the year **1986. **
 
• He choreographed the famous song **"Kahe Chhed Mohe" **from the movie **Devdas **and **"Mohe Rang Do Laal"** from **Bajirao Mastani.**
 
• Birju Maharaj is a renowned** Kathak dancer and choreographer.**
 
• He belongs to the** Kalka-Bindadin gharana of Lucknow.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uday Shankar** was a pioneer of modern dance in India and was awarded **Padma Vibhushan in 1971. **
 
• **Kelucharan Mohapatra** was a renowned Odissi dancer and choreographer who was awarded **Padma Vibhushan in 2000. **
 
• **Bipin Singh **was a Manipuri dancer who was awarded **Padma Shri in 1986. **
